title: KAIST International Undergraduate Admission 2027 (Regular Admission)
institution: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)
about: KAIST regular admission for international undergraduate applicants (Fall 2027 track) accepts applications from 10 November 2026 to 14 January 2027, 6:00 PM KST. Recommendation letters are due 21 January 2027; admission results are announced 25 March 2027.
requirements: International applicants; KAIST has no transfer programme for international students (freshman entry only)
For fall 2027: high-school graduation by 31 August 2027
card_alt: Card for KAIST International Undergraduate Admission 2027 (Regular Admission) at KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology) in Daejeon, South Korea; deadline 14 Jan 2027.
